Across is a cross-chain bridge protocol that moves assets between blockchains. Across relies on liquidity pools and relayers to fill transfers quickly. Across uses the UMA optimistic oracle to verify cross-chain transfers.

DeFiLlama is a analytics platform that tracks decentralized finance protocols. DeFiLlama reports total value locked across protocols and chains. DeFiLlama is a free, publicly accessible dashboard rather than a financial service that holds user funds.

Aave is a non-custodial lending and borrowing protocol. Aave requires overcollateralized loans. Aave offers flash loans that must be repaid within a single transaction. Aave is governed by holders of its AAVE token. Aave is deployed on several public blockchains.

Uniswap is a decentralized exchange for swapping tokens. Uniswap uses automated market maker liquidity pools instead of an order book. Uniswap lets liquidity providers earn trading fees. Uniswap version 3 supports concentrated liquidity. Uniswap is governed by holders of its UNI token.

Lens Protocol is a social graph protocol for decentralized social media rather than a financial service. Lens Protocol represents user profiles as non-fungible tokens. Lens Protocol was built on the Polygon blockchain.
